personality.description: This person is moderately curious and will try new ideas when they seem worthwhile, but usually prefers arrangements that feel familiar and stable. They tend to be spontaneous and flexible in daily habits, though they may be disorganized and sometimes overlook details or deadlines. In moral dilemmas, they usually respond with empathy and a strong desire to preserve harmony, looking for fair compromises rather than rigid rules or confrontation. In group discussions, they speak in a calm, approachable way, listen carefully to others, and are willing to contribute either actively or quietly depending on the situation.
